# AI Accelerator

A 2-day offsite to build your 2027 AI roadmap. Join a cohort of CEOs, or bring your leadership team.

[Start the conversation](#application)

Your browser doesn't support embedded video.

## The invitation

Your 2027 planning is coming up. Soon you'll sit down with your senior leadership team and set the direction for the year. AI will be part of that conversation, whether or not you've had time to think it through.

Most leaders haven't had that time. The inbox, the quarter and the team's questions fill the days, and “what does AI mean for our company?” gets a few minutes between meetings.

This is your chance to give it real attention. You get two days away from the office to focus on that one question, with seven other leaders who are working through it in their own companies. Hearing how they see it, and being asked a hard question by someone with nothing to protect, shows you things you would miss on your own.

On Day 1 you work out where your company stands on AI today, honestly. On Day 2 you decide where you want it to be and build the roadmap to get there. You go into your planning meeting with a clear view of what AI means for your business. Check-ins at 30, 60 and 90 days follow, because a plan only counts once it's under way.

At a glance

-   2 days
-   Maximum 8 seats
-   A roadmap for at least 2 areas of your business, such as sales or customer service
-   Check-ins at 30, 60 and 90 days
-   7 other leaders in the room

## Who qualifies

This is for business owners, startup founders, CEOs and other senior executives who have the authority, the budget and the desire to move AI forward in their company.

## This isn't a course

We start by measuring where your company stands on AI. Then we build your plan, and you leave with a way to track your progress at 30, 60 and 90 days.

## Meet your hosts

![Sam headshot](https://www.acme-advisory.example/founder.png)

### Sam

Sam Rivera has spent 25 years building business software companies. As VP of Product at Galvanize, he helped scale the company to a $1B exit. As Chief Product & Technology Officer at Boast AI, he led the move to AI in how the company built and delivered its product, and he still builds AI agents himself.

Through Acme Advisory, he advises executive teams on AI: where to start, what to build, and how to govern it, with a focus on sales, go-to-market and customer service.

![Atta headshot](https://www.acme-advisory.example/atta.png)

### Atta

Atta Emami has spent more than 20 years helping leaders and organizations navigate complexity, execute strategy, and lead through change. Over 6.5 years at Shopify, he coached senior leaders and executives and facilitated leadership teams through hypergrowth and repeated reorganizations. He also led large-scale organizational change at AIG across Asia Pacific and Latin America, reaching 22,000 employees and 3,800 line managers, and directed culture transformation at Central 1 Credit Union.

Through Acme Advisory, he advises executive teams on navigating AI transformation: clarifying the why, bringing their people along, strengthening leadership effectiveness, and creating the operating conditions that turn AI strategy into consistent execution.

> Sam is an experienced operator who has done this work himself. Working with him moved my understanding of AI forward quickly, and I now use it in my work every day.

Laurie Schultz

Board Director, Serial Chair, Investor, Technology CEO
